title: Find mini apps
summary: Mini apps and games on the community Hub that match what the person wants, as a numbered list they can open.
whenToUse: Use when the person asks for a mini app, a game or something on the Hub.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: What kind of mini app or game, such as 'puzzle game' or 'budget tracker'

example: Find me a puzzle game on the Hub
_note: Phase AV.22 (2026-11-12): the Hub applet for the agent, through its own service.
